description: This source file defines a custom NSView subclass, HoverChromeContainerView, that appears to be a container for web content or subviews with hover effects, draggable and resizable chrome overlays, and a close button. It manages user interactions, tracking areas, and overlay views to enhance the UI experience in a macOS app.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView
classes.description: A custom NSView that contains subviews with hover effects, supporting dragging, resizing, and closing functionalities via overlay controls.
